prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1391; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle was stationary when struck at the rear bumper by a third-party vehicle reversing out of a space. Both drivers reported no visible damage beyond scuffs. Liability appears clear on the third-party driver. Claimant reports a back strain and has retained counsel, so all further contact to go through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received a letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Requested medical authorization forms and the initial treatment records. Attorney's office confirmed the claimant has been seen at an urgent care facility and is following up with a primary care physician. Estimate on the rear bumper and tail light assembly requested from the repair shop; photos uploaded to the file.

Entry 3: Spoke with the attorney's paralegal regarding the status of the medical records. Urgent care notes received and reviewed. Diagnosis is lumbar strain with a recommendation for physical therapy and rest. No imaging performed at this time. Attorney's office indicated they will send a demand package once treatment is complete. Noted that the claimant has missed some work and will request wage documentation.

Entry 4: Repair estimate received and reviewed. Rear bumper replacement and tail light repair within expected range for the vehicle. Vehicle is currently at the repair shop awaiting parts. Rental coverage confirmed under the policy for the duration of repairs. Third-party carrier notified of liability position and asked to confirm their insured's coverage limits.

Entry 5: Third-party carrier confirmed coverage and has accepted liability in writing. Physical therapy records requested from the attorney's office for the next file review. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the bodily injury component. Diary set to follow up with counsel in two weeks for an update on treatment progress and the status of the demand package.
